claims.text: Role in ED: hypogonadism (endocrinopathy or aging w low testosterone) may ↓ libido and cause ED,
claims.quote: Any endocrinopathy or aging with testosterone deficiency (hypogonadism) may decrease libido and cause ED.

claims.text: but erectile funct only rarely improves w normal testosterone (most also have neurovascular causes);
claims.quote: However, erectile function only rarely improves with normalization of serum testosterone levels because most affected men also have neurovascular causes of ED.

claims.text: underlying disorders such as hypogonadism need their own tx.
claims.quote: Underlying organic disorders (eg, diabetes, prolactin-secreting pituitary adenoma, hypogonadism, Peyronie disease) require appropriate treatment.

claims.text: Testosterone gel (AndroGel) label: Boxed: virilization reported in children secondarily exposed;
claims.quote: Virilization has been reported in children who were secondarily exposed to testosterone gel

claims.text: children should avoid unwashed or unclothed application sites.
claims.quote: Children should avoid contact with unwashed or unclothed application sites in men using testosterone gel

claims.text: CI: breast CA or known or suspected prostate CA in men;
claims.quote: Men with carcinoma of the breast or known or suspected prostate cancer
Women who are pregnant. Testosterone may cause fetal harm

claims.text: Check Hct b4 starting, at 3 to 6 months, then annually; if elevated, stop until it falls.
claims.quote: Check hematocrit prior to initiating treatment. It would also be appropriate to re-evaluate the hematocrit 3 to 6 months after starting treatment, and then annually. If hematocrit becomes elevated, stop therapy until hematocrit decreases to an acceptable concentration.

claims.text: Suspected VTE: stop and work up.
claims.quote: If a venous thromboembolic event is suspected, discontinue treatment with AndroGel 1.62% and initiate appropriate workup and management

claims.text: BPH may worsen: monitor pts w BPH;
claims.quote: Patients with BPH treated with androgens are at an increased risk for worsening of signs and symptoms of BPH. Monitor patients with BPH for worsening signs and symptoms.
claims.locator: 5.4 Worsening of BPH and Potential Risk of Prostate Cancer

claims.text: evaluate for prostate CA b4 and during tx.
claims.quote: Patients treated with androgens may be at increased risk for prostate cancer. Evaluate patients for prostate cancer prior to initiating and during treatment with androgens
claims.locator: 5.4 Worsening of BPH and Potential Risk of Prostate Cancer

claims.text: Can ↑ BP: check BP periodically (esp in HTN); ⍉ recommended in uncontrolled HTN.
claims.quote: Monitor blood pressure periodically in men using Androgel 1.62%, especially men with hypertension. Androgel 1.62% is not recommended for use in patients with uncontrolled hypertension.
